note: The per-schedule storage prices of tools/deploy-plan.mjs GAS_SCHEDULES (the single source; docs/GAS-SCHEDULES.md's table is read from the EIP text and measured by test/integration/FloorPrices.t.sol), mirrored here for the Solidity suites, which cannot read a JS module; tools/test/gas-schedules.test.mjs fails when this file, the docs table or the floor prices differ from GAS_SCHEDULES. Execution gas is what the GAS opcode sees and what EIP-7825's 2^24 cap counts; state gas is EIP-8037's second dimension (zero on prague). The Realm's floor prices are floorFreshGas = freshSlot.executionGas and floorRewriteGas = rewriteColdSlot.executionGas (LIMITS and GLAMSTERDAM_FLOOR in tools/deploy-plan.mjs; test/harness/KernelDeploy.sol s1Limits() is checked against this file by FloorPrices.t.sol).
